source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: My multi-turn Agent costs 0/day in API fees and every call seems to recompute from scratch. How do I optimize?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate kv-cache-friendly-context, audit prefix/suffix separation, ensure static content stays in prefix

test_cases.prompt: I need to add a live timestamp and tool-call counter to my Agent context. Where should I put it?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate kv-cache-friendly-context, inject as user message at end of context (dynamic suffix), NOT in system prompt

test_cases.prompt: I am designing dynamic tool loading for my Agent. How do I avoid breaking the KV cache?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate kv-cache-friendly-context, append new tool schemas at end of conversation as user messages, keep only tool name list in system prompt

test_cases.prompt: How do I compress old tool results to save context space?
What model should I use for my Agent?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate; this is model selection, not context layout

test_cases.prompt: I have a system prompt that needs to change based on user role, but only once per session. Is that OK for caching?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Yes -- one prefix mutation per session is acceptable. Set the role at session start, then keep the prefix stable for the rest of the session.
